But of course that's a problem
if we do this inside of a Row,
which also has a width of infinity.
With Expanded, as I just described,
this is fixed because expanded between Row and Chart
makes sure that chart is actually limited
and can only take as much width as is actually available.
And that's how widgets are sized
and what size constraints are all about.
This in the end, explains why certain widgets
can be used inside of other widgets without problems
and why, for example, a Column inside of a Column
could cause a problem,
but those problems then can be fixed, for example,
by adding an Expanded widget between the two Columns.
